name: team_planning_status
description: Get the status of each planned change in a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, held against the Org Graph today (a UTC day, as known now). There is one status per subject and facet the scenario resolves, from its own changes and those it inherits from the scenarios it follows; scenario_id says which scenario made it (the plan_id is the baseline). 'done' when today reads the planned end state, 'pending' when today still reads what the plan's base held or what the step before plans, 'conflicting' when it reads none of these; before the plan's base date nothing reads conflicting. A person's placements are one facet, so a placement list is done only when the whole list matches. The Org Graph can't say which position someone fills, only where they are, so a placement in a position is done once the person is in the position's unit at its allocation, with its role only when the plan names one. A change the Org Graph never holds, such as a rule or a position, has no status: it would read pending forever. A unit retirement is done once the Org Graph has retired the unit. A unit succession is matched by its sides: done when the Org Graph holds one with the same predecessors and successors, conflicting when one shares a predecessor and names other successors. Subjects are named by id, and `names` maps each the Org Graph holds to a name; a forgotten person reads as "Former member", and a subject only the plan holds has none. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
